statement: The oldid-pinned WiiBrew Extension Controllers identification section documents the Classic Controller Pro six-byte extension identification as 01 00 A4 20 01 01 at 0xA400FA, in contrast to the original Classic Controller's 00 00 A4 20 01 01. Their trailing two-byte type/format suffix is shared (0x0101), which explains why Linux and SDL suffix-only classifiers cannot distinguish the two. This is community protocol documentation, not a new physical capture.

applicability.revision: WiiBrew community documented Wii Remote family; precise physical hardware variant not independently captured
applicability.scope: WiiBrew oldid 121955 section Identification; comparable pinned Linux core lines 431-450 and SDL 311-364. Complements wii-c5-extension-identifiers and pending PR #19's Classic-family classifier without editing them.
